title: マイルCSの後に・年度代表なるか？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When the dust settles on the heated clash, Silence Suzuka emerges victorious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The race now over, Silence Suzuka makes a revelation—Taiki's fiery running touched her to the core and showed her what she was missing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Both in search of higher speed, Suzuka announces her plans to run in Hong Kong, while Taiki sets the Yasuda Kinen as her next target.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Mile Championship behind us, all that's left is to wait for the Umamusume of the Year announcement. Will Taiki Shuttle achieve her ambition? Only time will tell.
